Your species produced enough plans for ending war and disease to require an index, then distributed them across a book so the index became another plan. Here is the repair.

An idea earns its own place here if a reader could **build, fund, pass, run, file, distribute, or test it**. Evidence, calculations, and future projections support those ideas. They do not become additional solutions merely by acquiring their own PDFs.

Not every idea is supposed to run at once. Some are the current route. Some are backup engines. Some are tools. Some are jokes. The cat-powered car is definitely a joke. This clarification is necessary because humans invented both parody and venture capital, then made them visually indistinguishable.

## The current integrated route

These parts form the current first implementation. Replace a tool if you have a better one. Do not remove the function it performs and announce that simplicity has been achieved.

- **Set the target:** [What Matters](../proof/what-matters.qmd) defines the objective as more pleasant conscious experience and less unpleasant conscious experience, measured publicly through healthy life and median income.
- **Close the loop:** [Theory of Operation](theory-of-operation.qmd) turns government into a feedback system with a target, controller, actuators, outcome sensors, and a wire that carries results back to the next decision.
- **Keep the whole design forkable:** [Earth Optimization Protocol v1](../strategy/earth-optimization-protocol-v1.qmd) connects the required functions while allowing better instruments to replace the current ones.
- **Continuously improve the manual:** [The Planetary Constitutional Convention](../strategy/planetary-constitutional-convention.qmd) requires proposed revisions to cover every necessary governance function, satisfy constitutional constraints, and survive adversarial review.
- **Create an operating company:** [Earth Optimization Services](earth-optimization-services.qmd) is the reader-owned wrapper that turns the manual into products, tasks, capital allocation, and execution.
- **Create concentrated political power:** [The Earth Optimization Fund](../economics/earth-optimization-fund.qmd) buys companies that already influence government, then uses ordinary shareholder rights to point that influence toward health and wealth.
- **Redirect the existing lobbyists:** [The Loving Takeover](../appendix/loving-takeover.qmd) acquires enough defense-company ownership to make supporting the treaty the profitable long-term strategy for shareholders, employees, directors, and customers.
- **Move the first large block of money:** [The 1% Treaty](1-percent-treaty.qmd) [@1-percent-treaty-paper-2025] [@1-pct-treaty-impact-paper-2025] redirects the same percentage of every signatory's military spending to clinical trials, preserving the military balance while reducing the number of weapons.
- **Receive and route the money:** [Decentralized Institutes of Health](dih.qmd) coordinates the health-industrial coalition, pays for results, publishes the data, and outsources execution to competing providers.
- **Make treatments teach humanity something:** [The decentralized FDA](dfda.qmd) [@dfda-spec-paper-2025; @dfda-impact-paper-2025] connects treatments, patients, outcome tracking, and pragmatic trials through an open protocol.
- **Let humans set priorities:** [Wishocracy](wishocracy.qmd) [@wishocracy-paper-2025] gives each verified person equal standing in bounded public-resource allocation without selling additional votes to people with additional papers.
- **Let evidence choose means:** [Optimocracy and the Optimitron](optimocracy.qmd) [@optimocracy-paper-2025] compare policies and budgets across jurisdictions, recommend what improves the target metrics, and mark failing programs for reduction.
- **Turn recommendations into assignments:** [The Decentralized To-Do List for Humanity](../strategy/humanity-todo-list.qmd) decomposes “optimize Earth” into ranked tasks, names the lowest-cost actor for each one, and records whether the work happened.
- **Make selfish behavior useful:** [Aligning Incentives](aligning-incentives.qmd) gives contractors, pharmaceutical companies, insurers, politicians, investors, and ordinary humans their own profitable reason to support the same outcome.

## Medical discovery and access

The medical engine is not one website. It is a family of compatible tools.

- **Continuous evidence generation:** [The two-stage dFDA protocol](../appendix/dfda-spec-paper.qmd) uses real-world evidence to find promising signals, then pragmatic trials to confirm them.
- **Treatment search and rankings:** [The dFDA interface](dfda.qmd) lets a patient search by condition, compare what worked for similar people, and find an available trial.
- **Outcome Labels:** [Nutrition-facts-style treatment labels](dfda.qmd) publish benefits, harms, uncertainty, and the population behind the estimate instead of hiding the useful facts in a pamphlet written by the seller.
- **A personal treatment assistant:** [The FDAi](dfda.qmd) matches a person's history and preferences to treatments, trials, and evidence that change as new outcomes arrive.
- **Continuous safety monitoring:** [Federated outcome tracking](dfda.qmd) detects harms and effectiveness changes across participating systems without requiring one organization to own every patient's data.
- **Commercial access after safety testing:** [The Right to Trial & FDA Upgrade Act](../appendix/right-to-trial-fda-upgrade-act.qmd) [@right-to-trial-paper-2025] permits access after initial human safety testing while requiring covered uses to generate evidence.
- **Patient-directed research allocation:** [The DIH](dih.qmd) lets patients choose trials while Wishocracy handles bounded infrastructure decisions, replacing grant-writing contests with demand and measured results.
- **Pay for outcomes and publish everything:** [The DIH data commons](dih.qmd) pays providers when useful work occurs and makes positive, negative, and boring results public.
- **Build rails, not every train:** [The open ecosystem and bounty model](../appendix/open-ecosystem-and-bounty-model.qmd) publishes interfaces and pays for completed components so many independent builders can supply the system.

## Evidence, budgets, and public control

- **Optimal Policy Generator:** [The OPG](../appendix/optimal-policy-generator-spec.qmd) [@opg-paper-2025] turns cross-jurisdiction causal evidence into prioritized enact, replace, repeal, or maintain recommendations.
- **Optimal Budget Generator:** [The OBG](../appendix/optimal-budget-generator-spec.qmd) [@obg-paper-2025] estimates where the next public dollar produces the most health and income, and which budget lines have passed the point of usefulness.
- **[Political Dysfunction Tax](../problem/unrepresentative-democracy.qmd) [@political-dysfunction-tax-paper-2025]:** [The dysfunction ledger](../appendix/political-dysfunction-tax.qmd) prices the gap between current outcomes and the outcomes available under better-tested policy.
- **[United States Efficiency Audit](../appendix/us-efficiency-audit.qmd) [@us-efficiency-audit-paper-2025]:** [The line-item audit](../appendix/us-efficiency-audit.qmd) identifies recoverable spending waste, compliance burdens, and policy-created economic losses.
- **Four separate ledgers:** [Theory of Operation](theory-of-operation.qmd) separates wishes, evidence, earned contribution, and capital so money cannot quietly become a vote, a fact, and a moral virtue at the same time.
- **Proof of personhood:** [The Earth Optimization Prize protocol](../appendix/earth-optimization-prize-protocol.qmd) [@earth-optimization-prize-paper-2025] [@earth-optimization-prize-protocol-paper-2025] defines interoperable identity providers and a shared nullifier system so one human receives one civic identity across participating pools.

## Ways to create political force

The current first route is EOS equity and shareholder control. The remaining mechanisms are complements, escalation paths, or alternatives if the first route is insufficient.

- **[Court of Humanity](court-of-humanity.qmd) [@court-of-humanity-paper-2025]:** [Any human may sue any government](court-of-humanity.qmd), [sovereign immunity](court-of-humanity.qmd) is not a defense, and the treaty is the standing settlement offer.
- **Legal architecture:** [The four-part legal framework](../legal/legal-framework.qmd) separates treaty, securities, political, and operational functions so helping humanity does not accidentally become several felonies stacked in a coat.
- **Election-law compliance:** [The election-law design](../legal/election-law.qmd) uses lobbying, campaign spending, and organizational forms that current law already permits.
- **Ready-to-file legislation:** [The legislation package](../strategy/legislation-package.qmd) gives lobbyists and legislators statutory text instead of asking them to convert a moral aspiration into legal syntax during lunch.
- **Incentive Alignment Bonds:** [IABs](incentive-alignment-bonds.qmd) [@iab-paper-2025] are the backup campaign-financing engine. Investors fund passage and become a permanent concentrated interest for maintaining and expanding the treaty.
- **Treaty financial plan:** [The raise, pass, manage model](../economics/treaty-financial-plan.qmd) separates campaign capital, treaty adoption, and the continuing allocation of treaty revenue.
- **Earth Optimization Prize:** [The outcome prize](../strategy/earth-optimization-prize.qmd) rewards verified recruitment and progress toward health and income targets while letting depositors retain a failure-state claim on the pool.
- **Parallel prize treasuries:** [The Prize Treasury](../economics/earth-optimization-prize-treasury.qmd) allows multiple independently custodied pools to support the same outcome instead of requiring one sacred bank account.
- **Earth Optimization Points:** [The prize protocol](../appendix/earth-optimization-prize-protocol.qmd) records verified contribution and uses those receipts for prize distribution without turning them into purchasable civic votes.
- **Global Referendum:** [A verified species-wide vote](../strategy/global-referendum.qmd) makes public support visible, difficult to counterfeit, and useful to every political path.
- **Declaration of Optimization:** [The declaration](../strategy/declaration-of-optimization.qmd) states the purpose, metrics, and grievances before asking anyone to ratify the machinery intended to fix them.
- **Earth Optimization Day:** [The annual action day](../strategy/earth-optimization-day.qmd) coordinates voting, public accountability, and a proposed one-percentage-point treaty ratchet around one recurring date.

## Government replacements

The suite replaces mechanical government functions with transparent rules while leaving value choices under human control.

- **Department of Peace:** [The replacement for the war department](department-of-peace.qmd) treats organized violence as a negative-return transaction and supplies four mechanisms of its own:
  - **Peace Payroll:** Pay leaders, commanders, and other pivotal humans more for declining war than they expect to gain from starting one.
  - **Settlement Engine:** Publish the expected cost of fighting beside the cost of settlement and finance the cheaper option.
  - **The Last War:** Let autonomous weapons destroy one another in an empty ocean, sell the broadcast, and direct the proceeds to clinical trials.
  - **The Very Strong Robot:** Locate weapons and remove them from Earth without asking the weapons to vote on it.
- **Automated Revenue Service:** [A transaction-level tax system](automated-revenue-service.qmd) collects simple rules automatically and eliminates filing as a household hobby.
- **Universal Security Administration:** [One universal transfer](universal-security-administration.qmd) replaces overlapping welfare programs, eligibility traps, and the bureaucracies guarding them.
- **Aligned Election Commission:** [A public alignment score](aligned-election-commission.qmd) connects campaign support to how closely an official's record matches constituents and evidence.
- **Decentralized Accountability Office:** [A public ledger](decentralized-accountability-office.qmd) makes transactions continuously auditable instead of discovering theft after everyone involved has retired.
- **Decentralized Census Bureau:** [Continuous population and welfare measurement](decentralized-census-bureau.qmd) replaces a periodic count and supplies the sensor array for the wider system.
- **Algorithmic Monetary Authority:** [A rules-based currency system](algorithmic-monetary-authority.qmd) targets stable prices and distributes newly created money without routing it through politically selected intermediaries first.
- **Transparent Securities Commission:** [Disclosure plus a competence check](transparent-securities-commission.qmd) replaces investor exclusion based on whether someone was already rich.
- **Drug Treatment Administration:** [Treatment replaces punishment](drug-treatment-administration.qmd) for addiction, changing the DEA into the DTA and moving the problem into the medical system.
- **Immigration Revenue Service:** [Legal entry by priced permits](immigration-revenue-service.qmd) replaces prohibition, collects part of the migration surplus, and distributes it to citizens.
- **Decentralized Congress:** [Evidence-backed direct questions](decentralized-congress.qmd) replace purchased intermediaries voting on documents they did not read.
- **[Algorithmic Public Administration](../futures/wishonia.qmd) [@algorithmic-public-administration-paper-2025]:** [The integrated protocol](../appendix/algorithmic-public-administration-paper.qmd) combines transparent accounting, preference aggregation, evidence, identity, automatic revenue, and rules-based monetary policy while preserving democratic control over ends.

## Coordination, recruitment, and distribution

- **Twenty Questions:** [A person-to-person call script](../strategy/questions.qmd) makes each participant explain the case to two more humans.
- **Nonprofit coalition:** [The coalition strategy](../strategy/nonprofit-coalition-strategy.qmd) lets existing organizations contribute audiences, endorsements, ad grants, and trusted distribution without surrendering their missions.
- **Voter-acquisition grants:** [The grant template](../grant-proposal/voter-acquisition-grant.qmd) funds a coordinator to combine nonprofit communication channels into referendum participation.
- **Pre-built advertising:** [The Google Ads package](../appendix/google-ads-campaign-template.qmd) gives coalition partners campaign copy, targeting, and landing paths they can load into existing ad grants.
- **AI coordination army:** [Agent coordination](ai-coordination-army.qmd) assigns, tracks, and verifies work at a scale human working memory cannot manage.
- **Recruitment before infrastructure:** [The recruitment and propaganda plan](../appendix/recruitment-and-propaganda-plan.qmd) builds a committed audience before requiring a complete organization or product.
- **First ninety days:** [Getting Started](../strategy/getting-started.qmd) sequences the smallest campaign, grant, embed, outreach, and prize-seeding actions for an operator with little time or staff.
- **Initiating node:** [The initiating-node model](../strategy/initiating-node-memo.qmd) lets one institution convene and publish the first bounded pilot without becoming the permanent sovereign.
- **Ninety-day institutional pilot:** [The pilot proposal](../grant-proposal/earth-optimization-prize-90-day-pilot.qmd) tests sponsorship, measurement, recruitment, and governance before scaling.
- **Institution outreach:** [Reusable outreach templates](../strategy/prize-institution-outreach-email.qmd) make hosting the first pilot a concrete yes-or-no decision instead of another meeting about meetings.
- **Campaign endorsement:** [The supporter survey](../strategy/ic2ewd-supporter-survey.qmd) gives organizations and individuals a defined endorsement path and specific contributions.
- **Orientation film:** [The educational film](../educational-film.qmd) compresses the system into a short, producible visual explanation.
- **Distribution checklist:** [The channel checklist](../strategy/distribution-checklist.qmd) converts book arguments into formats native to the places humans already waste time.
- **Correcting the AIs:** [Canonical correction templates](../appendix/correcting-the-ais.qmd) turn bad model answers into training feedback and point future answers toward sourced mechanisms.
- **Earth Optimization Commission:** [The commission](../strategy/earth-optimization-commission.qmd) appoints each participant President of Earth Optimization Services, asks what they would optimize first using the two metrics, and has each appoint successors.
- **The Funniest Show in the Universe:** [The interview show](../strategy/funniest-show-in-the-universe.qmd) turns the commission process into repeatable public media.
- **Special Education:** [Free role-specific tutoring](special-education.qmd) teaches each builder only the parts of the manual required for the job they accepted.

## Ready-to-use repair procedures

These are not arguments. They are printable or executable objects.

- **Vandalism handout:** [The two-sided handout](../appendix/handout.qmd) explains the [shirt campaign](../appendix/joke.qmd) [@joke-paper-2026] to the person whose closet has just been optimized without authorization.
- **The shirt and the funniest joke:** [The vandalism campaign](../appendix/joke.qmd) puts the message on clothing, distributes it through absurdity, and supplies the card and script that explain it.
- **President notification letter:** [The notification](../appendix/president-notification-letter.qmd) tells a newly recognized EOS President what the job is and where to begin.
- **Commission of the President:** [The printable commission](../appendix/commission-of-the-president.qmd) makes the appointment formal enough to frame and ridiculous enough to share.
- **Presidential inauguration:** [The two-minute ceremony](../appendix/presidential-inauguration-ceremony.qmd) commissions each new President and sends the appointment chain forward.
- **Humanity Manager agreement:** [The employment agreement, exam, and certificate](../appendix/humanity-manager-employment-agreement.qmd) turn reading into an accepted operational role.
- **Notice of termination:** [The termination letter](../appendix/notice-of-termination.qmd) gives officials who maintain the current military allocation a literal performance review.
- **Love letter:** [The friendly board letter](../appendix/love-letter.qmd) explains why redirecting lobbying toward health is in the recipient's financial and personal interest.
- **Shareholder demand and lawsuit:** [The filing kit](../appendix/lawsuit.qmd) uses one-share standing, fiduciary questions, and the treaty settlement to force a board response.
- **Per-contractor demand packets:** [The fact sheets](../appendix/pre-filled-demand-letters.qmd) supply addresses, filings, lobbying figures, and forums for specific defense contractors.
- **Plaintiff media kit:** [The press package](../appendix/plaintiff-media-kit.qmd) gives a filer the release, journalist list, interview answers, and follow-up materials needed to make the filing public.
- **Filing-day checklist:** [The one-page checklist](../appendix/filing-day-checklist.qmd) turns the shareholder action into a sequence a human can complete with a pen.
- **Rule 14a-8 proposal:** [The shareholder proposal](../appendix/shareholder-proposal-14a-8.qmd) supplies the ballot text, supporting statement, cover letter, and escalation path after the demand window.

## Downstream upgrades and deliberate nonsense

- **Optimized food system:** [Produce the useful molecules directly](optimized-food-system.qmd) instead of growing a conscious animal as inefficient biological middleware.
- **Personal optimization:** [The To-Do List](../strategy/humanity-todo-list.qmd) can nest “optimize your life” and “optimize your organization” beneath the planetary task instead of treating public and personal welfare as unrelated software projects.
- **Catsoline:** [A cat-powered car](../appendix/catsoline.qmd) is an intentionally false EOS product disclosure demonstrating that memorable nonsense spreads farther than correct brochures. Do not place a cat in an engine. Humans required this sentence.

## Ideas that change the reader instead of the machinery

These do not allocate a dollar or pass a law. They are decision tools intended to make someone use one of the mechanisms above.

- **Wishonia's Wager:** [Act when the downside and upside cannot be bounded](../proof/wishonias-wager.qmd), because ignoring a small probability of an enormous outcome is not caution. It is arithmetic avoidance.
- **The no-bad-guys diagnosis:** [Redesign incentives instead of hunting villains](../proof/no-bad-guys.qmd), because the destructive allocation emerged without requiring a secret meeting of everyone responsible.
- **The Biotechnological Imperative:** [Apply the universalization test](../proof/biotechnological-imperative.qmd): a civilization cannot rationally require everyone to fund killing before curing.
- **The repairable-body frame:** [Treat biology as machinery](../proof/body-as-repairable-machine.qmd), because cells, tissues, and organ systems already demonstrate replacement, repair, and reprogramming.
- **The epistemic reset:** [Assume a large fraction of inherited beliefs are wrong](../problem/i-am-retarded.qmd), including the political identities currently preventing the reader from evaluating unfamiliar mechanisms.
- **The genetic-slavery frame:** [Treat evolved drives as legacy hardware](../problem/genetic-slavery.qmd) rather than giving fear, tribalism, and status competition permanent authority over nuclear weapons.
- **The grandeur proof:** [Reject the delusion of insignificance](../proof/delusion-of-insignificance.qmd), because the universe telling itself it is too small to matter is still the universe making a decision.
- **The personal-benefits calculator:** [Price the reader's own upside](../call-to-action/your-personal-benefits.qmd) in health, lifetime income, taxes, and investment value.
- **The two futures:** [Compare Moronia and Wishonia](../futures.qmd) as complete trajectories rather than evaluating each reform against an imaginary status quo where nothing else changes.

## What is not counted twice

The proof chapters, economic models, detailed calculations, source collections, standalone papers, and future scenarios are the receipts. A paper that analyzes the 1% Treaty does not create a second treaty. A cost model for the dFDA does not create a second dFDA. A reference showing that pragmatic trials work does not create another trial protocol.

If an executable mechanism in the manual is missing from this index, then the index is wrong. Fix it. The whole system is open source because a civilization that cannot accept a correction is not an optimized civilization. It is a comments section with weapons.
